feeds.title: Boot World
feeds.description: Boot World is proud to be one of the first specialty boot stores in Southern California, now servicing the entire country. Harold Stone and Robert Villasenor, both veterans of the shoe industry, joined forces to found Boot World in December 1975. Together, they brought over 25 years of combined retail shoe experience to the table.

feeds.title: Duo Boots Blog
feeds.description: DuoBoots has been democratizing boots since 1974. At DuoBoots, we celebrate the fact that every woman is unique. Tall, short, athletic, slender, or curvy - our boots are designed to fit your calf, leg, and foot regardless of your shoe size, your dress size, or anything else. We are the only company in the world to offer our entire collection of calf-fit boots in eight calf sizes and nine shoe sizes.

feeds.title: Stitchdown
feeds.description: Stitchdown was founded on the idea that fantastic shoes are one of the most important investments any person can make: one that can make you feel legitimately amazing and wise, stylish, and pretty darn pleased with yourself with every single step. We feature all varieties of dress shoes, from loafers to longwings, and also higher-end boots.

feeds.title: Barker Shoes Blog
feeds.description: Barker Shoes have been an English tradition for 140 years. Only the most carefully selected leathers are used and the uppers are shaped on the last by hand. Many other traditional shoemaking methods are still employed including slow natural drying and polishing. Visit our blog to read the news and updates from our Earls Barton Factory.

feeds.title: Baker's Boots And Clothing Blog
feeds.description: Baker's Boots has been a family business since the very beginning. Our commitment to quality necessitates a steadfast dedication to exceptional customer service. Over time we have grown to meet the needs of our faithful customers, launching an interactive custom boot-building platform, Build-a-Boot.com. We only sell you what we ourselves will wear.

feeds.title: Frank's Handmade Boots Blog
feeds.description: Frank is the President and Owner of Frank's Boot Company. His career began over two decades ago, as General Manager of Nick's Custom Boots in Spokane, WA. Frank earned experience in all facets of the footwear business, from production and custom fitting to sales and service. In 2016, Frank's brand was born and we continue to do things the good old-fashioned way-building customers one boot at a time with the most discerning eyes.

feeds.title: Chisos Blog
feeds.description: Howdy! I'm Will, founder of Chisos. Our heritage leathers come from hand-selected dairy cow hides, sourced from regional farms and ranches. They are unique and durable, and we reduce the demand for juvenile animal harvesting. We utilize a lead-free tanning process and are conscious of our impact.

feeds.title: Lisa Sorrell Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Sorrell Blog is a blog about life as a bespoke boot maker. The blog discusses the art of making and designing boots at length.

feeds.title: Boyer's Bootnshoe Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog, Ask The Boot Guy where you can get all your questions about footwear answered by a knowledgeable shoe and boot cobbler! Our family business has been repairing footwear for our customers for over 100 years so you can trust we know boots inside and out!
